The '''Uniform of the Chiss Expansionary Defense Force''' was the [[Clothing/Legends|uniform]] used by the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] and subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The uniform had a shoulder patch bearing the [[Symbol of the Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|insignia of the Chiss Ascendancy]].<ref name="TORE" />
